answer_1.quote: We perform a systematic study of gender biases in cross-modal generation evaluation metrics using image captioning tasks ... We then evaluate five n-gram matching-based evaluation metrics ... and one model-based metric (CLIPScore) on the PAO-EVALBIAS dataset.

answer_2.quote: We then evaluate five n-gram matching-based evaluation metrics (BLEU-4, METEOR, ROUGE, CIDEr, and SPICE) and one model-based metric (CLIPScore) on the PAO-EVALBIAS dataset.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate the human correlations of each evaluation metric on Flickr8K-Expert
answer_4.guideline: Human judges rated captions and the metric scores were correlated with these human judgments.
